paragraphs: Rav Yehudah, brother of Rav Kahana.

[Chullin 111b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.111b.7) reads, “Rav Kahana, brother of Rav Yehudah, sat before Rav Huna.” [The Rosh](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_on_Chullin.8.28.1) reads, “Rav Kahana sat behind Rav Yehudah.”[^1][^2] Hyman reports the same wording from Dikdukei Soferim.

notes.text: In the linked Bavli, Rav Kahana is Rav Yehudah’s brother and sits before Rav Huna.

The linked Rosh says that Rav Kahana sat behind Rav Yehudah, and that Rav Yehudah sat before Rav Huna. Hyman also reports the “behind” reading from Dikdukei Soferim. [Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1696&lang=en) questions whether the notice should be headed Rav Yehudah.
